comments: Input facts: ego is the car initiator and agent1 the pedestrian responder; pedestrian movement is transverse to the outgoing trafficway and does not follow another trafficway. Chosen assumptions: a four-approach junction with single-lane incoming and outgoing roads. Ego starts 6–9 m before its incoming-lane end and commits to a left turn at 4.5–5 m/s, while agent1 crosses from the far sidewalk 6–8 m into the outgoing road at 1.2–1.4 m/s. After ego leaves its initial lane and comes within 18–19 m, agent1 increases speed to 2.8–3.2 m/s to clear the outgoing ego lane. Left-front placement is checked relative to ego initial travel direction. All geometry, timing and the 18 s horizon are chosen assumptions; no marked crosswalk or collision is required.
